title: Good Size
text: Good Size. This is a good size Christmas decoration for the wall or door. I found the paint job to be a bit messy - it's possible it was intentional, but I think it looks sloppy. I had to position the bow so it doesn't show the ties. It's okay, but it really looks like something I would see at the discount store. It's a little nicer than what I would find in the dollar store, but more like the $3 or $5 bins at Target.
